fact: The regulator INCM runs the Thinklab with technology incubators in operation and incubated startups, shown to a World Bank delegation on 28 May 2026.
UNCTAD says Mozambique has initiated the development of multiple STI parks, with Maluana Science and Technology Park established by the Council of Ministers in 2012 as one of four envisaged.

The AICS Maputo programme page says the VaMozDIGITAL! programme, with a EUR 10 million budget including EUR 7.5 million for AICS, aims to develop two tech hubs in the Central and Northern regions of Mozambique.
INCM launched the ThinkLab incubator in Maputo, whose first cycle took 12 startups in health, transport, finance, IT and AI, Club of Mozambique reports.
